SingleUserLock.title: SingleUserLock
SingleUserLock.description: Represents the strict single-user lock for the platform, ensuring only the initial registered user can access the system.

isInitialized.description: Whether the platform has been initialized by its primary owner.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the sole platform owner.

ownerEmail.description: Verified email address of the sole platform owner.

ownerName.description: Full name of the platform owner.

ownerFirstName.description: Legal first name of the owner.

ownerLastName.description: Legal last name of the owner.

authProvider.description: Authentication method used by the owner.

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent owner login.

/system_security/single_user_lock.description: Singleton configuration holding the sole owner lock. Once created, no further registrations are permitted.
